posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
BPT’s are available in course vm that one with <your_roll_no>@se2001. This one is not the course vm but your personal vm.

Please follow this video for VM login process.

Then,
mkdir -p se2001
cd se2001
mkdir -p BPT1_problem_{1..4}

You can refer to this TA session for solving vm problems - https://drive.google.com/file/d/1kU4zRRLnNKtF2ApU_9nU4rokpMe9ic56/view
